'''2001 Hexacon tournament (27 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG convention held in Hexacon 11, Scottsdale, Arizona on 27 July 2001. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2729">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-29-viper-drops-hexacon-phoenix-7-27-01d2729/ viper-drops-hexacon-phoenix-7-27-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 29 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-29-viper-drops-hexacon-phoenix-7-27-01d2729/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Hexacon 11, Scottsdale, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
